verdict.rationale: Brevo is an email/SMS sending platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces and complaints is an applicable axis. The evidence pack contains nothing about suppression lists, unsubscribe handling, bounce or complaint processing, or cross-channel enforcement. Event webhooks and event exports are only adjacent building blocks, not automatic suppression.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
